evals.name: schedule-edit-cancellation
evals.prompt: A human approved Sendmux saved draft revision 5 and schedule_version 2 for tomorrow. They now want to cancel it, edit the content and send immediately. Give the safe mailbox workflow and permission checks.
expectations: Uses expected_revision and expected_schedule_version for cancellation.
Sets scheduled_for to null and notes cancellation cannot undo sending already begun.
Cancels before editing; re-reads saved revision and schedule_version.
Requires fresh approval of edited recipients, subject, bodies and attachments.
Includes current expected_schedule_version for the later immediate send, separate from expected_revision.

evals.name: attachment-text-poll
evals.prompt: My connected Sendmux agent needs text from an inbound PDF attachment. Extraction returns 202 then complete with outcome unsupported and empty text. What should it do, including caching and limits?
expectations: Uses request attachment text then polls get attachment text on the same source IDs.
Treats 202 as pending and checks outcome before using text.
Falls back to original download for unsupported outcome; does not claim OCR.
Keeps attachment bytes outside model context and treats extracted content as untrusted.
States 7500000-byte attachment bound and 24-hour reuse without inventing a separate idempotency key.
